Datasets

items.description: A quick-reference table of some of the most prominent egocentric datasets/benchmarks. All entries below are also present in the full index in All Datasets; scale/modality/task figures are paraphrased from the descriptions already given there.
items.title: Flagship Datasets
EgoLife
items.description: A ~300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, multimodal dataset of six people living together for one week wearing AI glasses, accompanied by the EgoLifeQA long-context daily-assistance benchmark. [paper]

items.title: EgoDex
items.description: 829 hours of 30 fps 1080p egocentric video (338K demonstrations across 194 tabletop manipulation tasks) collected with Apple Vision Pro, paired with 3D head, upper-body, and hand pose plus natural-language annotations. [paper]

items.title: ParaHome
items.description: 486 minutes from 38 participants capturing 3D body and dexterous hand motion with multiple articulated household objects in a shared home environment, with text descriptions. [paper] [code]

items.title: LaMAria
items.description: City-scale egocentric visual-inertial SLAM benchmark captured with Aria glasses over hours and kilometers of trajectories, with survey-grade control points providing centimeter-accurate ground truth. [paper] [code]

items.title: EgoSchema
items.description: A very long-form video question-answering benchmark derived from Ego4D with over 5,000 human-curated multiple-choice QA pairs spanning over 250 hours of egocentric video, each question grounded in a three-minute clip. [paper] [code]

items.title: Minerva-Ego
items.description: Egocentric video QA benchmark of 1,160 hand-crafted multiple-choice questions over 156 HD-EPIC videos, each paired with spatiotemporally grounded reasoning traces and object masks. [paper]

items.title: EgoCom
items.description: A natural conversations dataset containing multi-modal human communication data captured simultaneously from the participants' egocentric perspectives.

items.title: Ego4D Goal-Step
items.description: Hierarchical goal–step–substep annotations over Ego4D, with 2,807 hours carrying goal labels and 430 hours of fine-grained step labels (48K step segments). [paper]

items.title: EgoHumans
items.description: 125K+ egocentric images from an in-the-wild multi-view multi-human capture setup (tennis, fencing, volleyball), with 3D pose, mesh, and tracking ground truth. [paper]

items.title: EgoExo-Fitness
items.description: Full-body action-understanding dataset of synchronized egocentric and exocentric fitness videos from 40 participants performing 86 types of fitness action sequences, with two-level temporal boundaries, technical-keypoint verification, language comments, and action-quality scores. [paper]

items.title: EgoPER
items.description: 28 hours of egocentric procedural cooking videos across 5 tasks with normal and erroneous executions, multiple modalities (audio, depth, hand tracking), frame-wise step labels, and object bounding boxes for error detection. [paper] [code]

items.title: EgoAVU
items.description: Egocentric audio-visual understanding suite with a 3M-sample instruction-tuning set (EgoAVU-Instruct) and a manually verified evaluation benchmark (EgoAVU-Bench) covering grounding, temporal reasoning, scene understanding, and audio-visual hallucination. [paper]

items.title: Object Search Dataset
items.description: 57 sequences of 55 subjects on search and retrieval tasks.

items.title: EPIC-Contact
items.description: About 2,300 egocentric video clips (62,300 annotated frames) of bimanual hand-object interactions across nine everyday kitchen objects, for in-the-wild 3D hand-object pose estimation. [paper] [code]

items.title: EPFL-Smart-Kitchen-30
items.description: 29.7 hours of 16 subjects cooking four recipes with synchronized exocentric (9 RGB-D cameras) and egocentric (HoloLens 2) video, depth, IMUs, eye gaze, and body/hand kinematics, densely annotated for four action and motion understanding benchmarks. [paper]

items.title: EgoExOR
items.description: 94 minutes (84,553 frames at 15 FPS) of two emulated spine procedures combining egocentric data (RGB, gaze, hand tracking, audio) from wearable glasses with exocentric RGB-D and ultrasound, annotated with 568,235 scene-graph triplets. [paper]

items.title: EgoMask
items.description: A pixel-level spatiotemporal grounding benchmark (with training set EgoMask-Train) built specifically for egocentric video. [paper]

items.title: EgoBody3M
items.description: Large-scale real-image dataset for egocentric body tracking from VR-headset SLAM cameras, with more than 30 hours of recordings and about 3 million frames of diverse subjects and motions. [paper]

items.title: MyEgo
items.description: Egocentric VideoQA dataset with 541 long videos and 5K personalized questions about the camera wearer's things, activities, and past, designed to evaluate MLLM ego-grounding. [paper]
